headline: Chiefs get the first down
what_happened: On a risky fourth down attempt, K.Tonga ran three yards up the middle to gain the distance needed for a new set of downs.
who: K.Tonga carried the ball for the Chiefs.
why_it_matters: This is great news for the Chiefs as they keep possession of the ball instead of giving it back. This play increased their chance of winning by 8 percentage points.
